messages:
mike_partnerships: FYI — Contoso procurement just flagged our Azure CSP PO (PO# 789012) as rejected. Reason: reseller entity on the marketplace listing doesn't match the entity on the customer's PO. They also say a reseller commission addendum is required before they can accept.

ana_finance: Can you attach the rejection email and the PO PDF? Need the tax IDs and their EORI/VAT to compare.

mike_partnerships: Attached the vendor response. PO PDF -> https://contoso.example/po/789012.pdf  (redacted). Their purchaser insists on the reseller's legal name matching the invoice.

james_sales: Contoso wants to route through their preferred reseller (NorthStar SI). We listed NorthStar as a channel partner, but the marketplace listing still shows Redwood as the seller-of-record. Might be the mismatch.

lena_legal: Typical cause: marketplace seller entity vs customer-facing reseller entity. Customer procurement often refuses POs unless seller == reseller. They also pasted a clause asking for a "non-solicit / commission addendum" referencing reseller fees. That's a legal addendum we haven't signed for marketplace listings.

kevin_ops: Marketplace platform (Azure) has strict seller-of-record constraints — changing that requires a new listing or partner connector update. Can we toggle "Reseller Billing" flag on the listing?

marketplace-bot: Azure Marketplace listing (redwood-inference-enterprise) status: active. Associated seller: Redwood Inc (TIN: 12-3456789). Partner linkage: NorthStar SI (partner-id: ns-3344).

ana_finance: If Contoso insists invoice must come from NorthStar, Finance needs a subcontractor invoice flow or we need a reseller pass-through arrangement. Both require: 1) signed addendum, 2) tax certificate, 3) updated invoice template with their legal name.

james_sales: Quick customer ask: they want the PO honored this quarter. Is there a temporary workaround? Maybe accept the PO and issue a credit note referencing NorthStar? Risky.

lena_legal: We can't misrepresent seller-of-record. Two safe options: 1) execute the reseller commission addendum + update listing (may take 5-7 business days), or 2) have NorthStar issue the invoice and we bill NorthStar under a partner MSP contract. Option 2 requires a commercial agreement with NorthStar and a purchase order to them.

mike_partnerships: Contoso procurement is pushing for option 1 (they want a signature). I'll ask NorthStar to sign the addendum. @ana_finance — can you prepare a draft addendum template (reseller commission + indemnity carve-outs) we can send to NorthStar?

ana_finance: I can prep a draft but need the commission rate and whether the fee is gross or net of tax. Also confirm whether NorthStar will be the invoiced party or if they simply get a commission.

james_sales: Commission is 12% of ARR, gross. They want it as a pass-through commission on the invoice.

kevin_ops: Heads-up: even after addendum signing, Azure may still require a listing update which triggers review and could block purchase for 48-72 hours. Recommend we request an expedited partner review from our MSP contact.

lena_legal: I'll draft the addendum with minimal changes: define reseller entity, commission schedule, data sharing clause, and an explicit waiver for marketplace seller-of-record representation. I'll send a redline within 3 hours.

mike_partnerships: Great. Contoso procurement is on standby. Tagging next steps: \n- lena_legal = draft addendum (ETA 3h)\n- ana_finance = prepare invoice template and tax ID checklist\n- mike_partnerships = coordinate NorthStar signature + ask Azure partner rep for expedited listing update\n- kevin_ops = monitor marketplace listing changes and flag any review delays

james_sales: I'll keep Contoso updated. If we need to escalate, I'll loop in our channel partner manager at Azure. :thumbsup:

marketplace-bot: Note: create a ticket with Azure partner support referencing case AZ-PL-12877 to request expedited listing update.

mike_partnerships: Thanks all — trying to keep this from slipping into a month-long PO loop. Will post updates here. :eyes:
